name: Tanioka Rentarou
source:
An erotic novelist currently in the middle of terrible writer's block.
Following the example of the great literary masters of old, he has checked into a ryokan for an extended stay so he can focus on his writing.
Captivated by Honoka's kindness and beauty, he begins acting out various scenarios with her —ostensibly as research for his work.

"It's no use... I can't make any progress on my new manuscript!"
